decision_conditions: The Council has considered your application and confirms that the proposals are acceptable as non-material amendments to the planning permission set out above. For the purposes of this decision, condition no.2 of planning permission 23/02195/FUL shall be replaced with the following condition: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: Site Location Plan 8609_PL_000 Rev CExisting Site Plan 8609_PL_001 Rev BExisting Landscape Elevations / Sections 8609_104General Arrangement and Indicative Levels 8609_PL_101 Rev ICross Section and Elevations 8609_PL_103 Rev FHardworks and Furniture Layout and Reference Plan 8609_PL_201 Rev FTypical Paving Details 8609_PL_202Granite Step Detail 8609_PL_206 Rev CFixed Raised Planter And Seating Edge Details Sheet 1 8609_PL_302 Rev BFixed Raised Planter And Seating Edge Details Sheet 2 8609_PL_303 Rev CArm Rest and Back Rest to Seating Edge to Raised Planter Details 8609_PL_304Gravity Fixed Semi-Permanent Seating Detail 8609_PL_305Softworks Layout and Reference Plan 8609_PL_401 Rev EPlanting Layout - Fixed Raised Planters 8609_PL_402 Rev BPlanting Layouts & Details Gravity Fixed Semi-Permanent Planters 8609_PL_403Planting Schedule 8609_PL_404 Rev ATree Pit Detail 8609_405 Rev ASemi-permanent Planter & Seat Sketch 8609_SK10Surface Water Catchment Plan 2721-CIV-XX-XX-D-C-30002 Rev F01;Sustainable Drainage Strategy, 14.09.2023Permeable Paving & Planter Hydraulic Connectivity 2721-CIV-XX-XX-SK-C-00007 Rev P03Lighting Design DOC-161738 0 -HD-23 0327-PG, September 2023, Hoare LeaReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
